Varra Park Hillside Stabilization

Project Information

The hillside to the north of Flatiron Crossing Mall in Frank Varra Park is experiencing slope failure, which is causing sections of the embankment to slide toward Rock Creek. To address this environmental and safety concern, CCOB has initiated the design for the Varra Park Hillside Stabilization Project.

Project Goals:

  • Stabilize the Hillside: Address the active erosion and prevent additional embankment slope failures.
  • Protect Public Infrastructure: Repair and secure the ground underneath the existing 8-foot concrete trail.
  • Ensure Public Safety: Provide a safe, stable and long-lasting trail network for the community.

Timeline

  • Data Gathering and Geotechnical Field Work: May - June2026
  • Preliminary Design: July - October 2026 (Completed)
  • Final Design: November - January 2027
  • Construction: TBD
